entities.summary: Sjafrie Sjamsoeddin (b. 1952-10-30, Makassar) was a public servant or civil administrator of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Makassar and Indonesia. Known in the fields of indonesia, military leaders & commanders, asia.
